name: listBorrowHistory
intent: Retrieve the selected user's loan history.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
post: Return the selected user's loan records.
difficulty_basis: User lookup and direct collection result.
conflicts: Positive Jest asserts JavaScript array identity rather than only collection contents. Negative Jest passes numeric 99 although preserved uid type is String.
scenarios: Returns user's loan list; array-identity assertion is representation-specific.
Unknown user explains rejection, but numeric uid is outside the declared input type.
effects_audit: Returned and unreturned loans are not filtered; no mutation inferred.

name: listHodingBook
intent: List the selected user's loans that have not been returned.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
post: Return exactly the user's loan records marked as not returned.
conflicts: Negative Jest passes numeric 99 for preserved String uid; no signature correction made.
scenarios: Unreturned loan included and returned loan excluded.
Unknown user guard explains rejection, but fixture uses out-of-type uid.
effects_audit: Result is Loan records, not Book/BookCopy objects; original spelling listHodingBook preserved.

name: listOverDueBook
intent: List copies associated with the selected user's unreturned loans that carry an overdue fee.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
The collection of this user's unreturned loans with positive overdue fees is defined.
post: Return the book copies linked to the user's unreturned loans with positive overdue fees.
missing: Original result specification is needed to resolve preserved Set(BookCopy) return type versus collected loan-to-copy values, which may repeat the same copy. No distinctness invariant or deduplication policy is supplied; positive Jest checks one matching copy only.
scenarios: Matching unreturned fee-positive loan's copy included; exclusivity, empty result and repeated-copy semantics untested.
Unknown String uid violates user existence; unchanged loan repository is a rejection convention.
effects_audit: Overdue criterion is positive fee, not date comparison. No fee computation, returned-loan inclusion or deduplication invented.

name: listReservationBook
intent: List the copies referenced by the selected user's reservations.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
The selected user's reservation collection is defined.
post: Return the copies referenced by the selected user's reservation records.
missing: Original result specification must resolve Set(BookCopy) return type versus potentially repeated copy values from multiple reservations. No uniqueness invariant or deduplication policy is established by the single-reservation Jest scenario.
scenarios: Referenced copy included; no test distinguishes duplicate reservation-copy projections.
Undefined reservation collection violates explicit guard.
effects_audit: No open-reservation filter added; source returns copies of all user reservation records, not only active ones.

name: listRecommendBook
intent: List the selected user's book recommendation records.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
The selected user's recommendation collection is defined.
post: Return the selected user's recommendation records.
scenarios: User's recommendation present in result; complete collection equality untested.
effects_audit: No recommendation creation, sorting or filtering inferred.
